    Add common coreutils and which binaries to qemu-accel
    
    Accelerate frequently invoked coreutils and which utilities (such as
    cp, dirname, basename, chmod, cut, install, ln, sort, tr, wc, which)
    as native x86_64 binaries during cross-compile builds, while keeping
    uname and arch unaccelerated to preserve target architecture reporting.
